value.rationale: The central complement is a canonical free action at Hamming threshold three; the geometric orbit is a natural persistent-topology quotient. The explicit surviving cup tower t,t^2,t^3,t^4 and its integral Bockstein square detect projective-type torsion invisible in Feng’s rational sphere counts and the 2026 characteristic-zero symmetry theorem.
